DifficultyAttributes.description:
Base class for difficulty attributes.

Contains the difficulty of a beatmap, as output by a difficulty calculator.

fields.star_rating: The combined star rating of all skills.

fields.aim_difficulty: The difficulty corresponding to the aim skill.
fields.aim_difficult_slider_count: The number of sliders weighted by difficulty.
fields.speed_difficulty: The difficulty corresponding to the speed skill.
fields.speed_note_count:
The number of clickable objects weighted by difficulty.
Related to speed_difficulty.
fields.flashlight_difficulty: The difficulty corresponding to the flashlight skill.
fields.reading_difficulty: The difficulty corresponding to the reading skill.
fields.slider_factor:
Describes how much of aim_difficulty is contributed by
hitcircles or sliders. A value closer to 1.0 indicates most of
aim_difficulty is contributed by hitcircles. A value closer to 0.0
indicates most of aim_difficulty is contributed by sliders.
fields.aim_top_weighted_slider_factor:
Describes how much of aim_difficult_strain_count
is contributed by hitcircles or sliders. A value closer to 0.0 indicates
most is contributed by hitcircles. A value closer to infinity indicates
most is contributed by sliders.
fields.speed_top_weighted_slider_factor:
Describes how much of
speed_difficult_strain_count is contributed by hitcircles or sliders.
A value closer to 0.0 indicates most is contributed by hitcircles.
A value closer to infinity indicates most is contributed by sliders.
fields.aim_difficult_strain_count: The count of difficult aim strains.
fields.speed_difficult_strain_count: The count of difficult speed strains.
fields.reading_difficult_note_count: The count of difficult reading notes.
fields.legacy_score_base_multiplier: The base multiplier for legacy scoring.
fields.hit_circle_count: The number of hitcircles in the beatmap.
fields.slider_count: The number of sliders in the beatmap.
fields.spinner_count: The number of spinners in the beatmap.

fields.mechanical_difficulty:
The difficulty corresponding to the mechanical
skills in osu!taiko. This includes colour and stamina combined.
fields.rhythm_difficulty: The difficulty corresponding to the rhythm skill.
fields.reading_difficulty: The difficulty corresponding to the reading skill.
fields.colour_difficulty: The difficulty corresponding to the colour skill.
fields.stamina_difficulty: The difficulty corresponding to the stamina skill.
fields.mono_stamina_factor:
The ratio of stamina difficulty from mono-color
(single colour) streams to total stamina difficulty.
fields.consistency_factor: The factor corresponding to the consistency of a map.

CatchDifficultyAttributes.description:
Difficulty attributes for osu!catch mode.

This class currently has no additional attributes beyond the base class.

ManiaDifficultyAttributes.description:
Difficulty attributes for osu!mania mode.

This class currently has no additional attributes beyond the base class.

fields.aim: The aim portion of the final performance points.
fields.speed: The speed portion of the final performance points.
fields.accuracy: The accuracy portion of the final performance points.
fields.flashlight: The flashlight portion of the final performance points.
fields.effective_miss_count:
Misses including an approximated amount of
slider breaks.
fields.speed_deviation: Approximated unstable rate. None if not available.
fields.combo_based_estimated_miss_count:
Estimated miss count based on the
player's combo.
fields.score_based_estimated_miss_count:
Estimated miss count based on the
player's score. None if not available.
fields.aim_estimated_slider_breaks:
Estimated number of slider breaks that
affected the aim portion.
fields.speed_estimated_slider_breaks:
Estimated number of slider breaks that
affected the speed portion.
fields.reading: The reading portion of the final performance points.

fields.difficulty: The difficulty portion of the final performance points.
fields.accuracy: The accuracy portion of the final performance points.
fields.estimated_unstable_rate: Approximated unstable rate. None if not available.

CatchPerformanceAttributes.description:
Performance attributes for osu!catch mode.

This class currently has no additional attributes beyond the base class.

fields.difficulty: The difficulty portion of the final performance points.

ScoreInfo.description:
Information about a score for performance calculation.

Contains the essential score statistics needed to calculate performance points:
combo, accuracy, hit counts, and optionally the legacy total score.

fields.max_combo: The maximum combo achieved in the score.
fields.accuracy: The accuracy of the score (0.0 to 1.0).
fields.count_great: Number of 300s (great hits). (osu!standard, osu!taiko, osu!catch, osu!mania)
fields.count_small_tick_miss: Number of small tick misses. (osu!catch only)
fields.count_small_tick_hit: Number of small tick hits. (osu!catch only)
fields.count_large_tick_miss: Number of large tick misses. (osu!standard, osu!catch)
fields.count_large_tick_hit: Number of large tick hits. (osu!catch only)
fields.count_slider_tail_hit: Number of slider tails hit. (osu!standard only)
fields.legacy_total_score: The legacy total score, if available.
